beats.label: So where does Handoff come from?
beats.cue: “Not the spec, not the bundle — the crew runtime hands every role a Handoff and a SendMessage to each peer, and pre-allows both.”
beats.script: Not the spec, not the bundle — the crew runtime hands every role a Handoff and a SendMessage to each peer, and pre-allows both. [[pause:1.5s]] This is an offline proof and should complete successfully. The installed crew-orchestrator imports both tool factories, pre-allows both patterns, and composeRoleTools builds them per role — which is why every role's declared tool list is empty.
